rationale: The assistant correctly identified the drawer left ajar, guided the customer to silence the alarm, shut the drawer and allow recovery of 2-4 hours, with no parts or unnecessary escalation. Weaknesses: it asked again about food condition after the customer had already answered it, so the customer had to repeat themselves. It also suggested holding buttons (Freezer Temp/Power Freeze) as a guess, and gave no advice on re-freezing or checking the soft ice cream, and no landlord pointer if the alarm recurs.
